heroHeadline: Saudi-Led Coalition Strikes Hundreds of Houthi Targets, Destroys Northern Yemen Ballistic Missile Depot
heroSubtitle: Yemen's presidency ordered the army to retake all Houthi-held territory, and government forces claim to have recaptured Mocha and the Dhubab district near Bab al-Mandeb and to have opened an offensive toward Sanaa. The army says 1,747 Houthi fighters were neutralised, a figure that is unverified. The Saudi-led coalition reported 97 attacks around Taiz on Oct 5, while the Houthis reportedly hold about 150 km of Red Sea coast and have cut the Taiz-Aden route.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
